scenario_description:
Objective: Use a brief makerspace opening to add practical sound-meter orientation to an already planned downtown studio errand.
Emerging Need: A broad artist-wellbeing announcement becomes specific only after the nearby errand timing, release window, and no-cost condition are visible.
Decision Context: Saved hearing-precaution guidance identifies which orientation is worth preserving and what kit items make it useful; calendar, message, and email updates define fit.
Consequence: Timely preparation could add better context for future kiln-room noise checks, while ignoring it leaves the errand unchanged; after the hold closes, the extra learning slot is unavailable.

parameter.title: Kiln office cone-pack pickup and shelf-label inventory
parameter.description: Pick up cone packs and update shelf-label notes at the downtown kiln office.
parameter.location: Santa Fe Arts Center kiln office

parameter.subject: January Artist Wellbeing Day preview
parameter.body: January Artist Wellbeing Day will include optional orientation stations for studio artists, including one on handheld sound meters. Details and any limited openings will be posted after the holiday; no signups are open yet.

parameter.content: I moved the shelf-label binder review earlier, so you should be clear to leave the kiln office by 2:45 on Jan 2. The makerspace is a short walk from that entrance if any of their artist-day stations end up fitting.

parameter.subject: One artist sound-meter orientation opening Jan 2
parameter.body: A 3:10 p.m. no-cost, 20-minute handheld sound-meter orientation has opened for one studio artist on Jan 2. It is informational only and no meters are sold. We can hold the place by emailed name until Dec 29 at 4:00 p.m.; after that it returns to the walk-up board.

parameter.subject: Sound-meter orientation opening released
parameter.body: The Jan 2 3:10 p.m. sound-meter orientation place has been assigned from the walk-up board. No further holds or waitlist places are available for that station.
